reproduction.sampler_parameterized_recipe:
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,sys,json,types,subprocess,time,hashlib,plistlib,uuid,os
repo=Path(os.environ['AGENTDECK_E1_WORKSPACE']);sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'scripts'))
def load(name,path):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m);return m
p=load('r7probe',repo/'scripts/scan-performance-serving.py');b=load('r7baseline',repo/'scripts/scan-performance-baseline.py');m=p.matrix
b.CLICK_STIMULUS=p.click_stimulus(b.CLICK_STIMULUS,click_dispatch='manual')
root=Path(os.environ['AGENTDECK_E1_FROZEN_ROOT']);home=root/'home';out=Path(sys.argv[1]);app=Path(sys.argv[2]);count=int(sys.argv[3]);assert not out.exists() and 1<=count<=100
prior=json.loads((repo/'docs/topics/scan-performance/evidence/serving-warm-auto100-20261015-r7.json').read_text())
assert p.sha(root/'auto-status-click')==prior['controller_hashes']['auto-status-click']
inventory=json.loads((root/'private-inventory.json').read_text())
for x in inventory:
 source=home/x['relative'];assert not source.is_symlink() and source.resolve().is_relative_to(home.resolve())
 assert source.stat().st_size==x['bytes'] and source.stat().st_mtime_ns==x['mtime_ns'] and p.sha(source)==x['sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(sorted(str(x['bytes'])+':'+x['sha256'] for x in inventory)).encode()).hexdigest()==prior['input']['corpus_sha256']
seeds=[x for x in root.glob('run-*/seed-imported') if {f.name:p.sha(f) for f in x.glob('*.sqlite3')}==prior['starting_database_sha256']];assert seeds
seed=m.validate_imported_seed(root,sorted(seeds)[0])
with (app/'Contents/Info.plist').open('rb') as f:bundle=plistlib.load(f)['CFBundleIdentifier']
if '.serving.' not in bundle:p.unique_bundle(app,uuid.uuid4().hex)
artifacts={k:p.sha(app/v) for k,v in {'app_sha256':'Contents/MacOS/AgentDeck','helper_sha256':'Contents/Helpers/agentdeck','framework_sha256':'Contents/Frameworks/AgentDeckShared.framework/Versions/A/AgentDeckShared','widget_sha256':'Contents/PlugIns/AgentDeckWidget.appex/Contents/MacOS/AgentDeckWidget'}.items()}
report={'kind':'scan-serving-r7-warm-candidate-v1','input':prior['input'],'identity':{'B':artifacts},'starting_database_sha256':prior['starting_database_sha256'],'samples':[],'events':[],'environment':{'harness_sha256':p.sha(Path(p.__file__)),'matrix_module_sha256':p.sha(Path(m.__file__))},'controller_sha256':p.sha(root/'auto-status-click'),'sampler_sha256':p.sha(Path(__file__)),'limitations':['B-only same-start diagnostic or candidate verification;not a fresh A/B comparison','external synthetic CGEvent;action entry to numeric bitmap/readback,not photon or physical mouse']}
state=json.loads((repo/'docs/evidence/records/scan-serving-rereview-r7-i7TyZQeK-state.json').read_text())
report['candidate_source_files_sha256']={f:p.sha(repo/f) for f in state['files'] if (repo/f).is_file()}
report['probe_export_identity']=json.loads(Path(os.environ['AGENTDECK_E1_PROBE_IDENTITY']).read_text())
report['purpose']='warm P01 candidate100' if count==100 else 'warm candidate pilot;not tail acceptance'
def launch(baseline,app,home,arm,warm_samples,wait_seconds,observer=None):
 seen=set()
 def observe():
  if observer:observer()
  path=home/'manual-click-progress.json'
  if not path.exists():return
  request=json.loads(path.read_text());instance=request.get('instance')
  if not instance or instance in seen or request.get('status')!='awaiting_visibility':return
  target=str(app/'Contents/MacOS/AgentDeck')
  check=subprocess.run([str(root/'auto-status-click'),target,'inspect'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  if check.returncode:raise RuntimeError('controller_inspect_failed:'+check.stdout.strip())
  time.sleep(1)
  profiler = None
  if os.environ.get("R7_STACK_SAMPLE"):
   pid=json.loads(check.stdout)["pid"]
   profiler=subprocess.Popen(["/usr/bin/sample",str(pid),"30","1","-mayDie","-file",os.environ["R7_STACK_SAMPLE"]],stdout=open(os.environ["R7_STACK_SAMPLE"]+".log","w"),stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   time.sleep(5)
  event=subprocess.run([str(root/'auto-status-click'),target,'click'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  if event.returncode:raise RuntimeError('controller_click_failed:'+event.stdout.strip())
  if profiler: profiler.wait(timeout=90)
  seen.add(instance);record=dict(json.loads(event.stdout),sequence=len(report['events'])+1,instance=instance,request=request['request'],arm=arm,target_app_sha256=artifacts['app_sha256'])
  report['events'].append(record);p.put(out,report)
 try:result=p.launch_manual(baseline,app,home,arm,warm_samples,wait_seconds,observer=observe)
 except Exception as e:
  result={'failure':str(e),'cleanup':p.stop_private_app(app)}
 if seen:
  result['input_provenance']=report['events'][-1];result['actual_input']='external CGEvent;not physical mouse'
 return result
args=types.SimpleNamespace(conditions=['warm'],measurement='native',arms=['B'],pairs=count,output=out,warm_samples=0,manual_wait_seconds=600)
def put_report(path,value):
 if count==100:
  values=[x['native']['firstClickToDataNanoseconds'] for x in value.get('samples',[]) if not x['native'].get('failure') and 'firstClickToDataNanoseconds' in x['native']]
  if sum(x>300_000_000 for x in values)>5 or sum(x>600_000_000 for x in values)>1:
   value['failure']='fixed_100_sample_P01_budget_already_disproved;incomplete_series_not_tail_acceptance'
   p.put(path,value)
   raise RuntimeError(value['failure'])
 p.put(path,value)
ops=types.SimpleNamespace(sha=p.sha,put=put_report,backup_databases=p.backup_databases,stop_private_app=p.stop_private_app,launch_manual=launch,__file__=p.__file__)
m.run_matrix(args,b,ops,{'B':app},home,seed,report)
assert len(report['events'])==len(report['samples'])==count
assert len({x['instance'] for x in report['events']})==count
assert all(s['starting_database_sha256']==prior['starting_database_sha256'] for s in report['samples'])
print(json.dumps({'samples':count,'same_input_and_seed':True,'summary':report['summary']}))
reproduction.recipe_note: Only local path bindings parameterized;recorded executed sampler SHA remains in report. Reports embed necessary numerical facts;temporary binaries/logs are not durable references.
